description: Get the details of a Polish legal act: status, dates, keywords, issuing authority, the Sejm prints of the bill and references to other acts (amending acts, consolidated texts, implementing acts…). Long reference lists are summarized per type; referenceType lists one type in full.

position.description: Position in the journal: the last part of the ELI (1 in DU/2024/1)

publisher.description: Journal the act was published in: DU for Dziennik Ustaw or MP for Monitor Polski. The ELI field of a legislative process (get-process, get-passed-processes) such as DU/2024/1 is exactly publisher/year/position, and so is the ELI of acts from search-acts

referenceType.description: Return all references of one type, e.g. Akty zmieniające (amending acts), Akty wykonawcze (implementing acts), Inf. o tekście jednolitym (consolidated texts), Akty uchylone (repealed acts) or Podstawa prawna (legal basis)

year.description: Year of publication: the middle part of the ELI (2024 in DU/2024/1)

name: get-act

ELI.description: European Legislation Identifier: publisher/year/position, e.g. DU/2024/1; its parts identify the act in get-act and get-act-text

announcementDate.description: Date of the act, i.e. of its signing (YYYY-MM-DD)

notice.description: Set when the Sejm API is unavailable and the data comes from a cache; it may be out of date

prints.description: Sejm prints of the bill; their number identifies the legislative process in get-process

references.description: References to other acts by type, e.g. Akty zmieniające (amending acts) or Inf. o tekście jednolitym (consolidated texts): lists of { id: ELI, art, date }. For acts with many references, each type is summarized as { count, newest }; get-act with referenceType lists one type in full

status.description: Legal status in Polish, e.g. obowiązujący or uchylony

textHTML.description: Whether get-act-text can return the text; otherwise the act is only a PDF

type.description: Type of act, e.g. Ustawa, Rozporządzenie or Obwieszczenie

title: Get a legal act
